source.title: Disenchantum Retail 12.1.5 source: session success counter and reagent aggregation
source.author: ZelionGG

notes: Primary-source code inspection at commit 3a338116: on UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED for spell 13262, increments in-memory Session.itemsDisenchanted (SecureDisenchant.lua 461-472). LOOT_READY/OPENED records itemID and quantity but sums Session.reagents[itemID] by session, not gear itemLink/bonus/actual ilvl linked to each successful cast (87-131). Defaults.lua persists filters/settings, not Session. Interrupted/failed casts are separately routed in Core.lua 474-488. Public 1.3 release notes describe a session recap, not a public player cohort. No independently observed disenchant operation, source gear ID, 0-inclusive denominator by output, output hit counts, stack histogram, skill/spec, or raw player export was obtained. Do not use in yield estimates; do not treat interface counters as research sample or 272246 selected 305 preview as live-at-DE item level. New potential acquisition: ask author for permissioned raw event-level data and identifiers; code itself does not supply it. Original by-name source hunts for 272246 Miststalker's Wristbands, Umbral Tin Ore 237362, Refulgent Copper Ore 237359, Brilliant Silver Ore 237365 and Tranquility Bloom 236761 returned previously indexed cohorts or guides; intentionally excluded duplicates.
lookingFor: New firsthand, zero-inclusive 12.1.5 Retail disenchant/prospect/mill event ledger with exact input item/bonus/ilvl, completed casts and ranked material count/hit histogram (T0026/T0039/T0005/T0003/T0002)
